results.title: Yan ta'adda sun hallaka sojojin Nijar 13 a wani hari da suka kai garin Sanam
results.content: Aƙalla sojojin Nijar 13 ne suka rasa rayukansu, yayinda wasu 20 suka jikkata a wani mummunan hari da ƴan ta’adda suka kai sansanin sojoji na Sanam da ke yammacin ƙasar, kamar yadda ma’aikatar tsaro ta ƙasar ta shaida.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Babban Ministan tsaron Najeriya ya ayyana kansa a matsayin ɗan jam'iyyar APC a hukumance
results.content: Ministan tsaron Najeriya Christopher Musa ya fito fili tare da ayyana kansa a matsayin cikakken ɗan jam’iyyar APC mai mulkin ƙasar.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Isra'ila ta yi barazanar raba Falasɗinawa miliyan 1 da muhallansu a zirin Gaza
results.content: Yayin da ake ci gaba da fargabar sake ɓarkewar faɗa a Zirin Gaza duk da yarjejeniyar tsagaita wutar da aka cimma, Isra'ila ta yi barazanar sake tilasta wa kusan Falasɗinawa miliyan ɗaya barin muhallansu, matuƙar ƙungiyar Hamas ta ƙi miƙa makamanta.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Ƙasashen AES sun shiga gagagrumin shirin noman shinkafa da wasu ƙasashen Afrika
results.content: Duk da cewa ƙasashen ƙungiyar Sahel ta AES, wato Mali, Burkina Faso, da Jamhuriyar Nijar, sun fice daga ƙungiyar ECOWAS a hukumance tun a watan Janairun 2025, sun haɗa kai da wasu ƙasashen yammacin Afirka 12 wajen shiga wani babban shirin noman shinkafa na dala miliyan 850.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Ɗan shugaban Uganda ya yi iƙirarin ƙwace wani yanki na DRC
results.content: Gwamnatin Jamhuriyar Demokraɗiyyar Congo (DRC) ta gayyaci babban jami’in ofishin jakadancin Uganda, domin neman ƙarin bayani biyo bayan wasu kalamai masu zafi da Babban Hafsan Sojojin Uganda kuma ɗa ga shugaba Yoweri Museveni, Janar Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ya wallafa a shafinsa na X game da rikicin da ke faruwa a DRC, inda kalaman nasa ke nuna goyon bayan ƙungiyoyin ƴan tawaye.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Larabawa ƴan ƙabilar Mahamid na ci gaba da ficewa daga Nijar
results.content: A Jamhuriyar Nijar,yayin da wa’adin da gwamnatin ƙasar ta baiwa Larabawa ƴan ƙabilar Mahamid na su fice daga ƙasar ke kara karatowa, rahotanni sun nuna cewa tuni da dama daga cikinsu suka tsallaka ƙasar a cikin yanayi na tursasawa ba tare da kare musu hakkkin su ba. results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Ƙasashen AES sun haɗa kai da wasu ƙasashen yammacin Afirka 12 a shirin noman shinkafa
results.content: Duk da cewa ƙasashen ƙungiyar Sahel ta AES, wato Mali, Burkina Faso, da Jamhuriyar Nijar, sun fice daga ƙungiyar ECOWAS a hukumance tun a watan Janairun 2025, sun haɗa kai da wasu ƙasashen yammacin Afirka 12 wajen shiga wani babban shirin noman shinkafa na dala miliyan 850. results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Zai yi wahala a iya kada Infantino a zaɓe mai zuwa-Lise Klaveness
results.content: Shugabar Hukumar Ƙwallon Ƙafa ta Norway, Lise Klaveness, wadda ta shahara wajen sukar shugaban hukumar ƙwallon ƙafa ta duniya FIFA, Gianni Infantino, ta amince cewa zai yi wahala a kayar da shi a zaɓen shugabancin hukumar, amma ta ce har yanzu akwai yiwuwar hakan.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Kotun sauraron ƙararrakin wasanni TAS ta yanke hukuncin maida wa Senegal kofin ta AFCON
results.content: A tsakiyar wannan makon ne dai kotun sauraron ƙararrakin wasanni ta Duniya CAS ta yanke hukuncin maida wa Senegal kofin gasar ƙasashen Afrika ta AFCON ta shekarar 2025 da hukumar CAF ta ƙwace daga hannunta ta kuma miƙa wa Morocco. Hukuncin dai ya kawo ƙarshen taƙaddama tsakanin ƙasashen biyu kan wasan ƙarshen da suka fafata a ranar 18 ga Janairun wannan shekara ta 2026.

results.title: Tinubu ya bai wa iyalan sojojin da suka mutu gidaje da naira miliyan 100-100
results.content: Shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu ya bai wa iyalan sojoji da mutane 25 da suka mutu a haɗarin jirgin sama naira miliyan ɗari-ɗari da kuma gidaje masu ɗakuna uku-uku a birnin Abuja.

results.title: Ruɗu ƴan Kwankwasiyya ke yi, babu hannun mu wajen kai Kwankwaso EFCC - Sanusi
results.content: Kwamishinan yaɗa labaran jihar Kano dake Najeriya, Sanusi Bature Dawakin Tofa ya ce babu hannun su a ƙorafin da wasu mutane suka kai EFCC domin tuhumar shugaban Kwankwasiyya kuma ɗan takarar mataimakin shugaban ƙasdar jam'iyyar NDC, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso.

results.title: Sojojin Rasha sama da 700,000 sun rasa ransu a yaƙin Ukraine - Rahoto
results.content: Wasu bayanan sirri da suka fita daga rumbunan adana bayanan sirri na Rasha, sun nuna cewa sama da sojojin ƙasar 700,000 sun mutu a yayin gwabzawa da Ukraine.

results.title: Rasha ta zargi Ukraine da yunƙurin faɗaɗa rikicin da ke tsakaninsu
results.content: Fadar Kremlin ta zargi Ukraine da ƙoƙarin faɗaɗa yaƙin da take yi da Rasha zuwa yankunan Mediterranean da Baltic, matakin da ta bayyana a matsayin mai matuƙar haɗari.

results.title: NDLEA ta kama wasu ƴan ƙasar Mexico dake sarrafa muggan ƙwayoyi a Najeriya
results.content: Hukumar NDLEA dake yaƙi da masu sha da sarrafa muggan ƙwayoyi a Najeriya ta sake kama wasu ƴan ƙasar Mexico guda biyar da suka kafa kamfanin sarrafa ƙwayar ‘methamphetamin’ a Enugu tare da taimakon wani ɗan Najeriya.

results.title: Masu cutar Ebola a Congo sun wuce 12,000 yayin da ake kokarin dakile annobar
results.content: Alƙaluman da gwamnatin Jamhuriyar Dimokaraɗiyyar Congo ta fitar sun nuna cewa adadin waɗanda suka kamu da cutar Ebola a ƙasar ya wuce mutane dubu 12, yayin da mutane kusan dubu 6, wato dubu 5 da 904 suka riga suka rasa rayukansu.

results.title: Ƴan gudun hijira a jihar Filato na cikin halin ƙunci
results.content: Yan gudun hijira a Jihar Filato dake Najeriya sun bayyana irin halin ƙuncin da suke ciki sakamakon barin muhallan su da suka yi a wasu kananan hukumomin Jihar, a daidai lokacin da gwamnatin Jihar ke jaddada kudurin ta na tabbatar da sake komawa garuruwan su. Rabiu Abdullahi Usman daga Jos, ya hada mana rahoto a kai.

results.title: Yarjejeniyar Lafiya tsakanin Najeriya da Amurka: Abin da Amurka za ta samu
results.content: A ƙarƙashin sabuwar yarjejeniyar haɗin gwiwa ta kiwon lafiya ta shekaru biyar, wato daga shekarar 2026 zuwa 2030, da gwamnatin Amurka ta ƙulla da Najeriya, Amurka za ta bayar da kuɗi kimanin dala biliyan 2 da miliyan 100 a matsayin tallafin kiwon lafiya ga Najeriya.
